title: Decision: Snapshot state counter before migration loop to prevent skip race
description:
In Store::migrate, the current PRAGMA user_version is read ONCE before the loop (line 165-167), then compared against a snapshot for each migration. This is correct because migrations are strictly ordered and additive: if migration N runs, every M < N also ran. The snapshot is never stale because:

1. Single-writer guarantee: each kithd opens exactly one Connection per mailbox
2. Migrations are purely additive (no down-migrations)
3. If current >= version, that migration already ran (either in this open or a previous one)

This prevents a subtle bug where re-reading current inside the loop could skip migrations if a concurrent writer advanced user_version — which can't happen here but is good practice for future maintainers to document explicitly.
